compatibleExistingPins.contract: Unchanged successful creation reply and rss creation audit; existing strict-wire controls must remain.
Capacity-first including paused rows; no capacity audit; actual store failures retain safe fixed text and one bounded rejection audit when writable.
Keep source normalization, SSRF, HTTPS, port and pre-trim byte-bound controls.
Keep the six existing feed commands, ManageGuild/default permissions, stable string ids, bounded list and state labels. No command registry count change is required by duplicate recovery.

contract.identity: Existing normalized guild/channel/kind/source tuple returns original id and observed enabled state; different channels, guilds, kinds and previously distinct RSS URLs remain distinct.
contract.preservation: Snapshot every relay and delivery column, including timestamps, creator, last check, pending claims, delivered receipts and nonces; duplicates must be byte-identical.
contract.reply: One private mention-suppressed bounded completion. Name already/existing, original backticked id and enabled/paused state; give copyable /feed-inspect id:<id> and /feed-pause or /feed-resume id:<id>. Never echo raw URLs, database strings or capabilities, and never claim creation.
contract.race: Independent pools, simultaneous identical adds, one stored relay; exactly one Created and one Existing typed outcome and one creation reply/audit.
contract.errorFences: Capacity-first at 25 rows, unrelated unique index and primary-key collisions, and closed-pool outage must not become Existing.
contract.audit: Recognized duplicates must not produce existing successful-kind feed.create or rejected-storage audits. No particular new duplicate audit action/name is mandated. Real unique failures retain feed.create/rejected with a bounded reason.
contract.http: Every command invocation records exactly the ephemeral defer and completion; no Discord channel read/post or publication. Source-fetch transport is not injectable on this command harness; this is not a claim of source-network observation.
contract.scope: Builder includes typed store/runtime implementation and command-reference guidance together; no migration, RSS equivalence redesign, new fetch, reset or automatic resume.
